item.title: Money-moving operations need idempotency_key
item.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only idempotency_key=None, check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key first and return the original result without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit entry. Introduced after double-refund incident INC-204.
